---
title: "GenAI Reflection"
---

## Tools Used

For this lab, I used GenAI assistance to understand the lab instructions, organize the website structure, draft page content, and check that the Quarto project follows the required GitHub Pages workflow.

## How It Helped

GenAI was useful for breaking down the task into smaller steps:

- Identify the required submission URL.
- Create the Quarto website files.
- Configure `_quarto.yml` with `output-dir: docs`.
- Add multiple pages with meaningful content.
- Render the project and prepare it for GitHub Pages.

It also helped improve the wording of the website so that the pages read more clearly and consistently.

## What Was Challenging

The main challenge was making sure that the website was not only created locally, but also prepared correctly for deployment.
For GitHub Pages, the rendered files need to be available in the `docs` folder, and the repository settings must point GitHub Pages to that folder.

## What I Learned

I learned that GenAI is most helpful when I already understand the goal and use it to support the workflow.
It can speed up writing and debugging, but I still need to verify the final result, understand the files that were created, and make sure the submission link points to the live website.
